checks.title: Secret store can reach its database
Secret store can use its KMS key
checks.message: Generating a data key was denied by AWS KMS.

resolution.summary: Grant the secret-store role access to the KMS key.
steps: Allow kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt and kms:DescribeKey on the key for the role in components.secret-store.serviceAccount.annotations (IRSA), or for the access key in providers.secretStore.awsKms.existingSecret.
Check that the key policy does not deny the role.

error.message: User: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/metorial-secret-store/i-0 is not authorized to perform: kms:GenerateDataKey
error.hint: The credentials are valid but lack permission for this operation. Grant the missing permission.
